item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
A localized ceasefire in Oleshky continues into a third day while Russian drones killed 14 people on a Ukrainian rail platform and struck another station, killing 13, and Russian forces are preparing new ballistic missile strikes according to Ukrainian intelligence. Investigators have concluded that Russia committed war crimes by targeting civilians. Germany and Ukraine are testing an armed ground robot for frontline deployment. The European Union has freed over 20 billion euros to potentially help Ukraine's defense, and there were 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Israeli raids across the West Bank injured Palestinians and led to arrests, while settlers assaulted activists and journalists in the occupied territory. Israel banned travel for Brad Lander after his detention in the West Bank and Jewish Israeli blocs rejected Palestinian support. In Gaza, Israeli strikes this week killed 21 people, an aid group reported worsening food insecurity as operations were sharply cut, and 21,440 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Saudi civil defense intercepted a Houthi missile over the Eastern Province and the coalition reported destroying additional missiles targeting Riyadh. Aden airport has reopened after the Houthi attack, and a Saudi strike killed 12 people in a residential area in Yemen. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

The Nasib border crossing has been reopened and a joint security committee and investigation into the strikes have been agreed. Floods have killed five people, including four children, in different parts of Syria. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Sudan's civil war: the situation
item.description:

The Sudanese army is accused of launching 162 drone attacks from Ethiopian territory, which Ethiopia denies. Women are increasingly serving as frontline responders as the siege worsens and civilian arrests rise. A UN agency reports that nearly 120,000 people have been displaced in Blue Nile state since January. The UAE federal court sentenced eight Sudanese defendants to life imprisonment for illegal arms trafficking to the Sudanese army, according to the court.

item.title: Ethiopia: the situation
item.description:

Airstrikes have been reported around Rama for a third consecutive day, while a drone strike hit the Hayiq Jari 2 IDP camp in Amhara, killing 16 civilians and injuring 22. Armed attackers killed at least 60 Orthodox Christians in Oromia and a drone hit a shelter in South Wollo Zone, causing further casualties. Major General Yohannes, a senior Tigray military commander, was captured near the Eritrean border. The UCDP recorded 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

African Union peacekeepers are withdrawing from four bases in Lower Shabelle and the UN political mission in Somalia has ended without a replacement, leaving the unresolved election dispute unaddressed. Ethiopia has received Russian fighter jets and is slated to receive S‑400 air-defence systems, adding a new external military dimension.
